_comment: RSS/Atom feeds the scraper reads. Each was checked by hand on 2026-11-12 (see 'note'). The scraper re-checks robots.txt on every run and skips a source whenever it is disallowed, unreachable or not a real feed. Set enabled=false to switch one off.

feeds.name: Gematsu
feeds.note: RSS 2.0 feed; robots.txt allows /feed (Crawl-delay 10, one request per run).

feeds.name: QooApp News
feeds.note: RSS 2.0 feed (Chinese edition; the /en/feed/ URL returns an empty body). robots.txt only blocks named AI/SEO bots.

feeds.name: Ruliweb News
feeds.note: RSS 2.0 feed; /news/rss is not in the robots.txt disallow list.

feeds.name: Inven
feeds.note: RSS 2.0 feed; path is not disallowed by robots.txt.

feeds.name: GamerBraves
feeds.note: WordPress feed exists, but the site answered robots.txt and the feed with a Cloudflare 403 challenge when checked. Left enabled: the scraper skips it automatically while robots.txt is unreadable.

feeds.name: Famitsu App
feeds.note: No feed: the URL returns the HTML homepage. Disabled (HTML scraping is out of scope).

feeds.name: GameWith
feeds.note: No feed found (404 on /feed and /rss). Disabled.

feeds.name: TapTap
feeds.note: No RSS feed (URL returns the HTML app shell). Disabled.

googlePlay.note: play.google.com/robots.txt allows /store/apps/details. Checked per region with the gl= parameter.

appStore.note: apps.apple.com/robots.txt allows /{country}/app/ pages. Only used for games that have an appStore link.
